title: Solving Quadratic Equations
page_title: Solving Quadratic Equations | Edexcel International A Level (IAL) Maths Revision Notes 2020

equations.alt: a x squared plus b x plus c equals 0
2 x squared plus 5 x space minus space 12 space equals space 0

blocks.md:
- We can solve quadratic equations when they are written in the form $ax^{2}+bx+c=0$
- If given an unusual looking equation, try to rearrange it into this form first
- The three ways to solve a quadratic you must know are

  - Factorising
  - Completing the square
  - Quadratic formula

blocks.text: How do I solve by factorisation?

blocks.md:
- Factorising is a great way to solve a quadratic quickly but won't work for all quadratics
- If the numbers are simple, try factorising first
- Once factorised, set each bracket to = 0 and solve

blocks.alt: Solving Quadratic Equations Notes Diagram 1, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.text: How do I solve by completing the square?

blocks.md:
- Completing the square will work for any quadratic
- Make sure you know how to complete the square
- Remember this will help with questions involving turning points too ![Solving Quadratic Equations Notes Diagram 2, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes](assets/04bb4311f7fe-2-2-4-solving-quadratic-equations-notes-diagram-.png)

blocks.text: How do I solve using the quadratic formula?

blocks.md:
- The quadratic formula might look complicated but it just uses the coefficients a, b and c from the quadratic equation
- The quadratic formula will work for any quadratic

blocks.alt: Solving Quadratic Equations Notes Diagram 3, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.text: How do I solve using a calculator?

blocks.md:
- Most calculators now have the ability to solve quadratics
- Get used to how your calculator functions work ![Solving Quadratic Equations Notes Diagram 4, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes](assets/69d44f436ac9-2-2-4-solving-quadratic-equations-notes-diagram-.png)
- So the solution to the quadratic equation $2x^{2}+5x-12=0$ are **x = 1.5** and **x = -4**

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md:
- A calculator can be super-efficient but be aware some marks are for method
- There will never be many marks for solving a quadratic at AS/A level
- Use your judgement:

  - is it a “show that” or “prove” question?
  - how many marks?
  - how long is the question?
- Remember the quadratic formula with a song... there are loads of fun ones on YouTube
